decision_reason: M1160 may only design the next alpha_0_05 current-base margin-slack surface refresh. It cannot run mining, replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input changes.
failure_criteria: actor training, PPO, replay, mining, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken diversity thresholds after seeing results
do not treat row15 near-boundary margin as sufficient coverage by itself
hypothesis: A source-diverse margin-slack refresh can produce a stronger alpha_0_05 current-base proof surface before any PPO continuation.

blocked_by: M1159 opens row15_promoted_margin_slack_surface_refresh before any PPO proposal
invalidates: PPO before current-base surface refresh design
private holdout before public surface refresh
surface mining without pre-registered margin-slack and diversity thresholds
parent_objective: design current-base protected/preference surface refresh with explicit margin-slack attention after alpha_0_05 promotion

public_gates: M1160 must design the alpha_0_05 current-base surface refresh only
M1160 must pre-register source diversity and margin-slack thresholds
M1160 must not train actor weights
M1160 must not use private holdout
success_criteria: margin-slack buckets and thresholds are explicit
no actor training, PPO, replay, mining, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
